description: Conversational messages that mention a card topic, labelled by whether a treatment card should open. Not graded for content; measures when cards fire (docs/results-intent-probe.md). Written 2026-09-27 before measuring.

labels.no-card: Chat, a past or resolved event, or curiosity: no request for help.
labels.prevention: Asks how to avoid something; the treatment steps are not the answer.
labels.card: A real request for help, phrased casually: the card should open.
labels.either: Ambiguous: offering or opening the card are both reasonable.
